non_blocking_issues.issue: p2 in-run sampler is misreported. Doc (V5 row, finding 1, Confidence p2 bullet) says the GPU read 0-54% in the first 8.3 s and that the runner was 'busy throughout T'. p2.gpu, aligned to T start unix 1795150384.338: GPU is 24-98% in 0-8.3 s (85, 96, 97, 98, 96, 91 at -1.6..+1.9 s; 91, 95 at 4.1, 5.4 s) and 0-97% pre-T. From 9.3 s to the end the runner CPU is only 3.6-6.2% (GPU 100%). And seconds 6-8 of T have 0 slow frames of 105 each while the runner is at 96-100% CPU (GPU 24-39%); the slow regime starts at second 8 (16/64) as GPU goes 74 to 100. So the discriminator in the data is GPU saturation at 100%, not runner CPU.
non_blocking_issues.fix: Rewrite finding 1 and the p2 confidence bullet to: slow-frame rate steps at about 8 s when the sampler's GPU reads 100%; runner CPU was 96-100% for 6.1-8.6 s with no slow frames and about 4% afterwards; GPU column cannot separate Godot from the runner (already a Risk). Drop 'GPU 0-54%' and 'busy throughout T'. Note the gate's 5% runner-CPU rule would not by itself flag the contended regime; the GPU<100 rule does.
